experimental_method: Dry CO2-rich mixtures (5% propane or 1% n-butane in CO2, prepared by weight) saturated with water or water+methanol vapour at laboratory temperature, then condensed at a lower set temperature; water content by Karl Fischer titration and methanol by GC; dew points of the resulting gas measured with a chilled-mirror instrument and a pressure transmitter.
uncertainties_stated: Water content 0.2% accuracy (Karl Fischer / wet gas meter); pressure transmitter max error 0.1%; supplier composition +-1% (absolute); validation on ethane and propane VLE: pressure 0.3-0.6%, temperature 0.1-0.2 K; test on methane+water+methanol: water content 9.3%, methanol 3.1%, dew pressure 4.2%, dew temperature 0.4 K average deviations.
quality_remarks: Authors note dew points inside solid-vapor conditions would be metastable. Table 2 gas 2 has T=207.9 K with P=2.5 (lower than the preceding 2.8 at 202.6 K), apparently a printing or measurement oddity; Table 2 not extracted. Water mole fraction is an 'experimental mean value' per dew-point curve, not per point.
not_extracted_tables: Table 1 (supplier composition of Gas 1, Gas 2): composition only
Table 2 (dry dew points of propane/n-butane + CO2 gases, no water): no in-scope water component; hydrocarbon dew points of dry CO2 mixture
Table 5 (summary of ranges and model AAD values): derived/model comparison
